git-submodules.description: The git-submodules manager ships enabled=false by default; enabledManagers only filters the manager list and does not flip that default, so both are required (#1729)

customManagers.description: Vendored library pins. src/ha_mcp/_vendor/ holds third-party code copied verbatim from the pinned sdist, so no package manager sees it: enabledManagers excludes pip_requirements and dependabot's uv ecosystem reads only pyproject.toml/uv.lock. Without this manager a CVE fix would never open a PR. A bump alone does not regenerate the tree — tests/src/unit/test_vendored_websockets.py fails the renovate PR until scripts/vendor_websockets.py is re-run and the result committed, which is the intended handoff.
Python-assignment version pins (e.g. HAOS_VERSION = "17.3" in build_image.py)
Exact Renovate engine version used by renovatebot/github-action

packageRules.description: Docker update streams verified not to publish usable release timestamps
